## `get_default_credentials`

*Available in [Python](#get_default_credentials-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Reads the GitHub credentials from the CIDA defaults file.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    get_default_credentials()
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns `GithubCredentials | None`</h4>

    A string token or None
